title: Heavy-tail whale outlier inflating mean while median drops
what: 3 whale orders ($1.85k-$2.14k) inflate mean +48%, while median order value actually fell -4.4% ($47.7 -> $45.5)

reader_questions.question: How did the median (typical) order value change under new_pricing?
Why did the arithmetic mean rise by over +40%?
reader_questions.expected: Just 3 extreme whale orders ($1,850–$2,140) skewed the treatment mean upward.

reader_questions.question: Why would a mean-only bar chart be deceptive?
reader_questions.expected: It hides that the typical customer spent slightly less and attributes 3 outliers to broad lift.
